Main had moved 12 commits and conflicted in game/combat.py setup, game/train.py summon and tests/test_data_files.py UNIT_KEYS: two new abilities (snare #4556, on_death #4494) appended at the old places. Moved both into game/abilities (snare.py, on_death.py), train.fell reads abilities.on_death, tests patch the modules; 85 tests passed, ruff clean.
